title: descurainia incisa subsp. viscosa
intro: Descurainia incisa subsp. viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Tansy, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, with health benefits that include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sticky Tansy include analgesia, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it useful for treating pain, muscle spasms, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Sticky Tansy include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
